chunks: My father narrated to him, may God be pleased with him, who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to me, who said: Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd narrated to me, on the authority of Sulayman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fari, on the authority of al-Rida, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of his forefathers, peace be upon them.

That the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) loved four tribes: he loved the Ansar, Abd al-Qays, Aslam, and Banu Tamim. And he disliked Banu Umayya, Banu Hanif, Banu Thaqif, and Banu Hudhayl. And he (peace be upon him) said: 'My mother did not give birth to me as a Bakriyyah nor a Thaqafiyyah.' And he (peace be upon him) said: 'In every tribe there is nobility, except in Banu Umayya.'

key_terms.الأنصار: The Helpers, the tribe of Medina
key_terms.بكرية: From the Bakr ibn Wa'il tribe
key_terms.بني تميم: Banu Tamim, a major Arab tribe
key_terms.بني ثقيف: Banu Thaqif, a tribe from Ta'if

ai.seo_question: Which four tribes did the Prophet Muhammad love and which four did he dislike according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal* highlights the Prophet’s tribal preferences, which Shia scholars often interpret as reflecting both historical alliances and the spiritual nobility (*najaba*) inherent in specific lineages. The exclusion of Banu Umayya is particularly significant in Shia historiography, foreshadowing their political dominance and the subsequent rivalry with the Ahl al-Bayt. The Prophet’s remark regarding his mother’s lineage underscores the purity of the Prophet’s own origin, distinct from the major Qurayshi tribes.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-64 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, on the authority of Suleiman ibn Ja’far al-Ja’fari, on the authority of Al-Ridha (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB),

“God’s Prophet (MGB) liked four tribes: the Helpers (Ansar); Abdul Qyas; Aslam; and Tamim tribe. God’s Prophet (MGB) disliked four tribes: the Umayyads; the Hanif tribe; the Thaqif tribe; and the Hazil tribe. The Prophet (MGB) said, ‘My mother who delivered me was not from the Bakr tribe or the Thaqif tribe.’ He (MGB) also said, ‘There are some noble people in all tribes except for the Umayyads.’”
